line: Commander, the Elementals are gathering at the Void. The Convergence begins in ten minutes. Watch it, or strike now while they are apart.
Commander, a Clean Sweep! All five Elementals fell before the fusion, and the Convergence never formed. Everyone who fought them can claim the spoils.
Commander, the Pentarch's core has shattered! Its shards are raining across the galaxy. Gather them before they fade.
Commander, Glacius has been torn loose from the Pentarch! Its frost is gone from the Convergence.
Commander, Ignis has been torn loose from the Pentarch! Its fire is gone from the Convergence.
Commander, Solara has been torn loose from the Pentarch! Its light is gone from the Convergence.
Commander, Voltaris has been torn loose from the Pentarch! Its storm is gone from the Convergence.
Commander, Verdanth has been torn loose from the Pentarch! Its green is gone from the Convergence.

Every other Wednesday at eighteen hundred UTC, five Elementals tear through the Void for forty-eight hours. For the first day they stain the worlds around them with their element. Then the survivors fuse into the Pentarch above the black hole. Every Elemental we slay first is dark in it, and if all five fall it never forms. In the fight, it tears an element loose at every fifth of its hull, and aiming at a wing breaks it sooner.
